audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Graves, Skill, Gwen, Gwen, Graves, Gwen, Gwen while whys[0] concedes Level 1 outright, whys[1] and whys[2] describe Levels 2-3 as your window, and whys[3] calls 4-5 a skill check on baiting Mist.
audit.why: The mirror audit (gwen vs graves) is already on disk and set the chart to Gwen / Graves / Graves / Skill / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen, explicitly declining the packet's 'Graves at 6'. This side must restate it inverted.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Gwen, Graves, Graves, Skill, Gwen, Gwen, Gwen, with Gwen rows at 3/10, Graves rows at 6/10, the even row at 5/10, and five phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your spike. Hallowed Mist (22/21/20/19/18s) makes her untargetable to anyone outside the cloud, so Collateral Damage (100/80/60s) is blanked on demand — the level belongs to her.
audit.why: A 100s ultimate that a 22s W can nullify is not a spike you own; it is a window you have to earn by baiting the W first.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and phases[4].why now state the Mist timer and that your R only exists in the seconds she is targetable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen was called a blind in five places (whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0], early, wants.you[0], plus report[10]). Riot's text is a sight-range reduction with impact magic damage and a brief slow — her Skip 'n Slash empowered autos still land inside it.
audit.why: The whole 'W-blind her empowered autos and free-hit her' plan does not exist. The cloud's real value is that she loses sight of you and eats the slow.
audit.corrected: All rewritten to sight cut plus slow. The genuinely decisive interaction is kept and sharpened: Hallowed Mist blanks your autos, End of the Line and Collateral Damage from outside, so bait it before committing.

audit.why: packet flagged 'Snip Snip's' and 'Snip Snip' as probable wrong names — false positives on the exclamation mark; Snip Snip! is Gwen's real Q.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: Snip Snip! true-damages your last-hits from outside shell range and you have no E to close with yet.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: Quickdraw lands before her E/W combo — dash in and dump a full magazine while she is still only Q chip.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Full kit: dash in, fog her sight, and burst point-blank before her scaling arrives — your best window.

edits.before: Trade in shell rhythm: two autos and out. Track Hallowed Mist; your armor stacks from E make his short trades unprofitable.
edits.after: You win the raw all-in, but Hallowed Mist (22s) makes her untargetable from outside — bait it before you commit.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Six is hers: Collateral Damage cannot touch her inside Mist, so it only lands the second she steps out.

edits.before: You hit your shell-burst spike before her E/W combo — W-blind her empowered autos and dump a full magazine while she's still just Q chip.
edits.after: You hit your shell-burst spike before her E/W combo — Smoke Screen cuts her sight and slows, then dump a full magazine while she's just Q chip.

edits.before: Full kit online: dash in, Smoke Screen the empowered auto, and burst her down point-blank in the window before her scaling kicks in.
edits.after: Full kit online: dash in, fog her with Smoke Screen so she loses you, and burst her point-blank before her scaling kicks in.

edits.before: Collateral Damage catches her the instant she leaves Mist (it can't touch her inside the cloud) — your hardest nuke and cleanest kill of the game.
edits.after: Six is hers on the timer: Hallowed Mist is a 22s answer that blanks Collateral Damage from outside, so your nuke only exists as she steps out.

edits.before: Your point-blank shell burst is online before Gwen's E/W combo is — walk up and W-blind her so her empowered autos whiff, then unload a full 4-shell magazine while she only has Snip Snip's true-damage center to poke back. This is the cleanest you out-DPS her all game.
edits.after: Your point-blank shell burst is online before Gwen's E/W combo is — walk up and Smoke Screen her so she loses sight of you and eats the slow, then unload a full 4-shell magazine while she only has Snip Snip!'s true-damage center to answer. This is the cleanest you out-DPS her all game.

edits.before: Win the Level 2-3 window — W-blind Gwen's empowered autos, then dump a full magazine point-blank while she only has Snip Snip true-damage chip to answer
edits.after: Win the Level 2-3 window — Smoke Screen to cut her sight and slow her, then dump a full magazine point-blank while she only has Snip Snip! chip to answer

edits.before: "Level 1 is Gwen's: Snip Snip true-damages your last-hits from outside your point-blank shell range, and you have no E charges yet to close the gap, so don't walk up and trade autos. But Levels 2-3 are YOUR window — the moment you have your shells and W online, throw Smoke Screen on her so the blind eats her empowered autos, dash in, and dump a full magazine of close-range spread while she's still squishy and can only chip you with Q's true-damage center. This short stretch is the only time you cleanly out-DPS her, so trade hard and look for a kill."
edits.after: "Level 1 is Gwen's: Snip Snip! true-damages your last-hits from outside your point-blank shell range, and you have no E charges yet to close the gap, so don't walk up and trade autos. But Levels 2-3 are YOUR window — the moment you have your shells and W online, throw Smoke Screen on her to cut her sight and slow her (it never blinds), dash in, and dump a full magazine of close-range spread while she's still squishy and can only chip with Q's true-damage center. This stretch is the only time you cleanly out-DPS her, so trade hard."

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

notes: Chart restated to match the already-written mirror (gwen__graves): Gwen at 1, Graves at 2-3, even at 4-5, Gwen from 6 onward. Smoke Screen blind claims removed from five places — it is a sight cut plus brief slow, and Skip 'n Slash empowered autos still land inside the cloud. Both packet suspectNames (Snip Snip) are false positives on the exclamation mark.
